_comment: Observed market prices for the sources that have no queryable API. Every number here was read off a real listing — some collected by hand, most collected by research/pricing/scrape from indiahandmade, goswadeshi and itokri, which publish their catalogues openly. NOT generated, NOT estimated, NOT modelled. Collection protocol and the reasons for every rule: research/pricing/README.md. Build this file with `python3 research/pricing/pricing.py build`.
_sample: Each category/source list is capped at 200 prices, evenly spaced through the sorted observations, so the cheapest and dearest are exact and the quantiles between them move by about two percent at the tail. The full set lives in research/pricing/observed.csv, which is gitignored. `n` in RESULTS.md is the observation count, not the count kept here.
_warning: Do not invent numbers here. This file feeds the price an artisan is shown and the validation of whether our cost-up floor matches reality. A plausible-looking guess is worse than an empty file, because an empty file prices honestly on cost alone and a guess does not.
